test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Sharpness and accuracy of judgment
solution: The correct answer is** 'Acumen'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is **'Acumen'**. • It means 'the ability to understand and judge things quickly and clearly'. (स्थिति को तुरंत और स्‍पष्‍टता से समझ लेने की योग्‍यता; विदग्‍धता, कुशाग्रबुद्धि)__ __ • Example: *business/financial acumen...* Correct Answer: **Acumen** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Experience:** the things that you have done in your life; the knowledge or skill that you get from seeing or doing something. (जीवन में किए गए काम; किसी काम कों देखने अथवा करने से प्राप्त ज्ञान अथवा कौशल, अनुभव, तजुरबा) • **Estimation:** opinion or judgment. (मत, विचार या परख) • **Knowledge:** knowledge (of about something) information, understanding, and skills that you have gained through learning or experience. (शिक्षा या अनुभव से प्राप्‍त जानकारी, समझ और कौशल) 155:T9bb, The erroneous word is **"Exclaimation".**
